{{Top|leg}}
The '''invasion of Talay''' saw the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] invade the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talay/Legends|Talay]], the site of a major [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost and communications hub. The Empire had previously attempted to conquer Talay in the early years of the [[Great Galactic War]], but lost in the [[Battle of Talay]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Arkous]] oversaw the second invasion [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the [[Galactic War]], though he was nearly [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] before he could complete the offensive.<ref name="Journal">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20140731|text=Lana Beniko's Journal: Darth Arkous}}</ref>
